name: prompt-studio
title: Prompt Studio
description: Find and reuse prompts across coding tools
author: alex_grama

preferences.name: libraryDirectory
preferences.title: Prompt Directory
preferences.description: Absolute path or ~/ path containing Prompt Studio Markdown files

preferences.name: qmdExecutable
preferences.title: QMD Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to qmd; conventional macOS install paths are detected automatically

preferences.name: projectRoots
preferences.title: Project Roots
preferences.description: Folders Prompt Studio may scan for saved Git repositories; you can also choose one exact repo directly in Enhance Prompt

preferences.name: sshProjectRoot
preferences.title: Mac Mini Project Root
preferences.description: Optional read-only SSH source in host:path form; leave blank to disable

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Shared encrypted preference for Enhance Prompt and Capture Inbox; read only after an explicit OpenAI action

preferences.name: defaultEnhancementProfile
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: The enhancement profile Enhance Prompt starts with; a Disabled provider falls back to OpenAI Standard

preferences.name: selfReviewPass
preferences.title: Quality
preferences.label: Independent self-review pass
preferences.description: Runs a second model pass that reviews the compiled prompt against your original thoughts. Roughly doubles the enhancement cost.

preferences.name: variantCount
preferences.description: Generate several candidates, score each with a blind judge, and preselect the winner. Multiplies the enhancement cost by the number of variants and adds one judge call each.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Read only after you start an Anthropic enhancement; leave blank to type a one-run key each time

preferences.name: googleApiKey
preferences.title: Google API Key
preferences.description: Read only after you start a Google enhancement; leave blank to type a one-run key each time

preferences.name: context7ApiKey
preferences.title: Context7 API Key
preferences.description: Read only after you approve a Context7 documentation request; falls back to the CONTEXT7_API_KEY environment variable

preferences.name: exaApiKey
preferences.title: Exa API Key
preferences.description: Read only after you approve an Exa search and its maximum cost; leave blank to type a one-run key each time

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: Read only after you approve a read-only public GitHub search; leave blank to type a one-run token each time

preferences.name: researchContext7
preferences.title: Research Suppliers
preferences.label: Context7 library documentation
preferences.description: Allow Context7 when the task names a technical library

preferences.name: researchExa
preferences.label: Exa deep search
preferences.description: Allow Exa on Deep research; each search shows its maximum cost before it runs

preferences.name: researchWeb
preferences.label: Current web research
preferences.description: Allow current-web retrieval when the task depends on a fact outside library documentation

preferences.name: researchGithub
preferences.label: GitHub read-only search
preferences.description: Allow read-only public GitHub searches when the task names upstream code or history

commands.name: browse-prompts
commands.title: Prompt Library
commands.description: Find, preview, paste, and manage saved prompts

commands.name: enhance-prompt
commands.title: Enhance Prompt
commands.description: Turn an idea into a complete prompt when enhancement is activated

commands.name: idea-studio
commands.title: Capture Inbox
commands.description: Review and manage captured text, next prompts, and ideas

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.description: Save selected or clipboard text to Capture Inbox immediately

commands.name: menubar-prompts
commands.title: Frequent Prompts Menu
commands.description: Copy frequent prompts from the macOS menu bar

commands.name: paste-top-prompt
commands.title: Paste Top Prompt
commands.description: Paste the prompt bound to your current project, or your most-used prompt, without opening a list

scripts.lint: eslint src test evals/*.mts cli/*.mts mcp/*.mts scripts/*.mts --max-warnings=0
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src test evals/*.mts cli/*.mts mcp/*.mts scripts/*.mts --fix
scripts.check:store: pnpm test:store-core && pnpm package:store && npm --prefix dist-store ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix dist-store run lint && npm --prefix dist-store run build
scripts.publish:store: pnpm package:store && npm --prefix dist-store ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix dist-store run publish
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm verify:mcp-runtime && pnpm verify:mcp-bundle && pnpm verify:mcp-mutations && pnpm verify:feedback-cli && pnpm verify:optimization-cli
